card.name: Inside sympathomimetic and similar long words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long word that is split up, most often the "im" in sympathomimetic(s) in drug-interaction lists. It also fires on pieces inside words like Programming and development.

modes.label: Sympathomimetic
modes.description: The "im" piece in sympathomimetic drugs, named in interaction or overdose text.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle pieces of other long words in general web text, such as programming or development.
modes.example: better understand the early childhood develop<<men>> of at-risk children.

card.plain: It fires partway through long, split-up words, especially sympathomimetic, in drug-interaction lists.
